scope: DWG-derived SAT v1 to DXF group 1/3 framing; no general ACIS or 3D support claim
motivation: ACadSharp PR #1150 reports that SAT tokens split across DXF values can fail native restoration. Compare byte-identical SAT content with only the continuation boundary changed, and check the patched libdxfrw writer.

construction.authoring: ezdxf 1.4.5 body_from_mesh(forms.cube()), exported as ACIS 700 SAT and R2010 ASCII DXF; 217 spaces added before a forward token in one face record; locally generated only
construction.controls: Both padded inputs contain the same encoded SAT bytes. The unsafe group boundary cuts forward after six characters at encoded offset 255; the safe boundary is at offset 249 before the entire token. An unpadded generated cube is the baseline.

peer.converter: ODA File Converter 27.10.0.0 Linux x64 in an offline container, Xvfb, audit flag 0
peer.operation: DXF to AC2010 DWG and back to AC2010 DXF; ezdxf 1.4.5 loads the resulting SAT bodies
peer.baseline: one body, one mesh, eight vertices, six faces
peer.safe: one body, one mesh, eight vertices, six faces
peer.unsafe: 3DSOLID exists but SAT parser fails: expected bool string reversed or forward, got forwar
peer.candidate: The actual patched libdxfrw writer emitted the same locally generated padded cube in AC1015 DXF; ODA converted it to AC2010 DWG and back, and ezdxf loaded one body, one mesh, eight vertices and six faces.

implementation: The DWG-derived SAT v1 output path packs whole whitespace-delimited tokens, keeping @length strings and their embedded spaces in one value and caret escape pairs intact. It refuses malformed length strings and tokens exceeding the encoded 255-byte budget. Existing retained DXF payload replay remains on the original path.
validation: Focused macOS ARM64 CTests libdxfrw_dxf_modeler_sat_token_chunks, dwg2dxf_modeler_sat_token_transaction, and dwg2dxf_modeler_dxf_writer_matrix: 3/3 pass. ASCII and binary controls cover exact decoded payload, length-prefixed strings, unsplittable and malformed refusal, preexisting destination preservation, same-writer corrected retry and fresh readback.
limitations: One locally authored cube and one ODA version do not establish AutoCAD acceptance, universal SAT grammar, or independent ACIS geometry-kernel correctness.
An oversized single SAT token is refused because this profile has no independently qualified way to split it safely.
No new DWG or DXF fixture is committed; all artifacts remain scratch-only.
P7-C, P7-D, P7-F and P7-H remain open; no R2013+ shell or AC1012 dictionary merge semantics are inferred.
